authority: POWO/WCVP direct species/rank pages; ITIS and USACE where noted

records.synonym_note: ITIS treats Thelesperma filifolium var. filifolium as not accepted, synonym of accepted T. filifolium (Hook.) A.Gray. POWO accepts species without recognized accepted varieties; historical T. filifolium var. intermedium is also synonym of species. Do not treat source variety as independent learner species.
records.concept_action: Map historical nominate-variety source label to existing thelesperma-filifolium species; preserve alias and source rank.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts the variety under T. megapotamicum; homotypic synonym Thelesperma ambiguum A.Gray, heterotypic synonym T. fraternum Shinners. Alternative taxonomic treatments recognize T. ambiguum at species rank; do not confuse accepted parent species with this variety.
records.concept_action: Preserve current variety-rank canonical concept and alias mapping; no installation or range decision.

records.synonym_note: POWO/WCVP accepts T. kunthii and places it in Aspleniaceae, whereas USACE National Wetland Plant List uses Thelypteridaceae; Pelazoneuron kunthii and Thelypteris normalis are historical names. Family classification is authority-dependent; preserve project family index for separate backbone reconciliation.
records.concept_action: Record authority discrepancy only; do not edit canonical family, family/genus modules or derived Sheet family columns.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts Tillandsia recurvata (L.) L.; Renealmia recurvata L. is homotypic synonym. Tillandsia recurvata (Gaudich.) Baker is an illegitimate later homonym synonymized to Vriesea recurvata, NOT this accepted species; author citation prevents erroneous alias mapping.
records.concept_action: Retain accepted Tillandsia recurvata (L.) L. and distinguish author-specific later homonym; no canonical change.
